parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique UUID of the event.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 500.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are deployed. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are deployed in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are deployed in regions outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.
